From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Needham Energy evaluation - access, timelines, and POC ownership

Hi Evan & Priya,

Great to speak earlier — thanks for walking through the objectives and the initial workload profile. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have the plan in one place.

Top-level success criteria (agreed on call):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for 1k token responses under expected concurrency (10-15 reqs/sec).
- Cost: token cost below your internal benchmark of $0.004/token for the evaluation workload.
- Quality: completion-level BLEU/ROUGE-like checks + 10 customer-facing prompts passing our shared acceptance set.

POC/Trial scope and timeline:
- Duration: 2 weeks of active evaluation after access is provisioned (target start: Mon 10/05).
- Deliverables: sample ingestion demo, XRequest latency dashboard, and short report on cost/latency tradeoffs.

Ownership:
- Redwood contact (technical): Grace O'Connor (SE) — will handle model selection, test harness, and runbook.
- Redwood contact (account): Ben Carter — commercial and milestone coordination.
- Needham contact: Priya Rao — technical lead for internal whitelisting and test data access.

Immediate asks from Needham to kick off (can you confirm by EOD?):
1) SSO invites for your three engineers (emails you mentioned) or we can provision API keys if you prefer non-SSO.
2) IP ranges to add to our allowlist (we'll share a template).
3) Any internal compliance docs we should review before live credentials (optional).

I'll attach the short trial access guide and an IP allowlist CSV template. Once we get the SSO invites or the IPs, Grace will spin up a dedicated trial environment and share keys.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

- We prefer SSO for auditability. Please send SAML/SCIM invite flow. Our identity admin (Michael Dunn, cc'd on this thread) will handle the add.
- IP allowlisting: I'll get the infra team's outbound NAT ranges (should be 3 contiguous CIDRs) and send them first thing Monday.
- Test dataset: we'll share a redacted sample of 25 prompts + expected outputs by Monday afternoon.

Confirming internal attendees for trial access:
- Priya Rao (prao@needhamenergy.com) — trial lead
- Alan Cho (alan.cho@needhamenergy.com) — backend engineer
- Paige Martinez (p.martinez@needhamenergy.com) — security admin

Thanks,
Priya

1) SSO: We support SAML-based SSO + SCIM provisioning. I'll send a separate SAML metadata bundle and invite flow. For speed, we can also provision short-lived API keys for Alan to run initial workloads while SSO is configured.

2) IP allowlist: attached the CSV template (same as in the guide). If you paste your three CIDRs into the file and reply, we'll push them to the trial environment firewall.

3) Region: yes — the trial will be hosted in us-west-2 per your preference. Grace will confirm once the environment is ready.

Action items I will take now:
- Share SAML metadata + SCIM endpoint details (link in Drive).
- Provision an initial set of API keys for Alan (scoped to evaluation) and share them via the secure link.
- Schedule a kickoff sync for Mon 10/05 at 10:00 PT — 30 minutes to demo the test harness and walk through the evaluation checklist.

Grace & Laura — can you coordinate on the environment provisioning? Grace, you'll lead the test harness onboarding; Laura, please authorize the trial instance provisioning and review SLA notes with the customer.
